note: Set A binds every claim to the generator speed low-pass filter and correctly captures the corner frequency (0.25 Hz at the -3 dB point), the 0.0125 s time step and the recursive single-pole type, with Bode readings that match Figure 7-1; its defects are three unsupported/contradictory readings at 1.00 Hz (-72 deg, -80 deg, -12.5 dB) plus some duplication. Set B does capture the A_d/B_d/C_d/D_d definitions and the state/output equations that A omits, but it repeats them many times under an entity name ('Baseline Control-Measurement Filter') that appears nowhere on the page, misbinds D_d as an input matrix, misstates the corner frequency as '0.25 fraction', and invents a -3 dB point at ~0.3 Hz and a -80 deg phase that contradicts its own quote (-75). On balance A is the more faithful and better-bound set despite omitting the matrix definitions.
